items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee confirms Belle Wallace was present at the venue with Jackie Gleason ('Yes, it was. She was gorgeous.') but does not describe a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction with her.

ctx.x: Opening night, after following Benny Carter with that fifteen piece band, the boss said, my god, you'll have to play louder or something. The second night we were there, Jackie Gleason, who we were working with out in the Queens Terrace, he came in----with one of the most beautiful movie stars you ever saw, I forget--I think
it was Belle Wallace. He came in with her-- She was supposed to be what's his name's girlfriend--Earl--

Yes, it was. She was gorgeous. Anyway, when Jackie Gleason and all that bunch started coming in, the manager, Billy Berg, started saying why didn't I book you guys here before, and we started loading them then with movie stars; Lena Horne, all of them just packed in there.
